title: Yellowed Crisp Australian Tofu Frittata
description: A rich and crisp Australian dish featuring chives and tofu, perfect for a brunch mood, this plant-based friendly frittata is made in a mason jar with a lamination puff crust, this is a great option for those looking for a satisfying and filling meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry and cut it into a circle to fit the top of a mason jar.
In a bowl, whisk together the soy milk, mushroom broth, turmeric, salt, black pepper, and nutritional yeast.
Add the crumbled tofu to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the chopped chives to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the tofu mixture into a mason jar.
Place the puff pastry circle on top of the mason jar and brush with olive oil.
Bake the frittata for 35 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the frittata warm and enjoy.
